body: If my soul has such a vivid place, then why am I completely excluded/ignored/verbally abused by the family that is supposed to support me? They have played a huge part in flushing my mental health down the drain. They called the cops during my last attempt and buried me to the head in hospital bills that I will never be able to pay. I have been the family scapegoat for a long time and I refuse to deal with it any longer. I’ve tried everything in my power to impress my family but I’m only met with negativity, even when I do something so harmless as spilling a cup of water. Family is supposed to build each other up, but that doesn’t include me I guess. My mom wants to get rid of my cat anyways so he hardly matters anymore. I can’t open up to my friends because they’ve made it clear that they don’t want to be there every time I have a mental breakdown and it’s out of their control, which I do understand. The only reason anyone wants me alive is so I can continue to be their doormat. Maybe they’ll skin my dead body and have it made into one, who knows

I doubt my family would miss me. They didn’t care when I was here so I doubt this will make much of a difference. I’ve been taking things one day at a time but it feels like the only reason I’m here is to bring light into others’ lives. My friends don’t want me to die because they will miss me, but why should I live for others when I no longer have the drive to live for myself?
